goalCardinality.rule: goals[] cardinality equals the original owner-question cardinality, not the number of subtasks, claims, formal calls, or business outcomes
goalCardinality.validator: strict; duplicate, extra, and missing questionIndex values remain GOAL_STATUS_MISSING
goalCardinality.finalizer: combines all supporting fact IDs for one owner question into its one goal

noShortage.rule: a no-shortage claim requires formal ready readiness, a COMPLETE shortage collection, and formal returnedCount=0 plus totalCount=0
noShortage.normalization: formal canProduce=true is a ready-equivalent when the producer uses a localized readiness verdict

partialPurchaseCollection.rule: a verified PARTIAL collection may be delivered as PARTIAL with returned rows and an explicit more-records disclosure; it cannot be described as complete
partialPurchaseCollection.pendingOnlyFormalMeaning: pendingOnly=true filters formal purchase tasks to pendingQty > 0
partialPurchaseCollection.toolDiscoveryMetadata: pending/unfinished procurement is documented as the owner-language alias for this formal filter

postFreezeFinding.reason: fresh W1-06 sample exposed an additional local grammar defect: 缺 1 项物料 was classified as SHORTAGE rather than SHORTAGE_LINE_COUNT. The R3 product commit was already frozen, so it was not repaired in place.
